verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical: a sensible left-to-right banner with the quote mark, quote and attribution on a shared left edge and the bottle on the right. Both share the same flaws. The SOLSTICE logo sits outside the text column's left edge and is crammed into the bottom-left corner. The circle is cropped at the bottom, and the bottle sits high in it, off-centre, with a lot of empty maroon space below. A is worse because its logo is shrunk and the SOLSTICE wordmark looks squeezed or broken. B keeps the logo at a readable size and in proportion.
